Victory controls challenge coin visibility. meansOfDeath>0 hides killer/weapon displays and inversely reveals self-caused/means-of-death displays. summary.answer: Hides the vertical scrollbar when totalYDistance is zero. Otherwise shows it and computes the displayed fraction from (viewHeight - totalYDistance) / viewHeight; top-anchored and bottom-anchored branches set different top/bottom percentages from currentYOffset. No zero-height guard is shown. Uses 500/50 scroll-repeat values and defaults an absent target to the root. Interactive mode enables up/down mouse buttons and registers bar press/release/lose-focus/capture-lost/close/drag handlers plus background paging. Press asserts unlocked focus, captures the mouse and saves contact offsets. Release/lose-focus/close release capture and clear state; capture-lost clears state. Drag clamps normalized Y, optionally reverses it and scrolls. The disabled branch keeps bar/background unfocusable on updates. Wheel-down/up callbacks still register after either branch, scroll by opposite wheelScrollUnit values and return true; their prompt callbacks return false. When ContextualMenu exists, removes matching focusable paths during an ipairs traversal, closes and clears the contextual menu, then attaches a one-unit timer that force-notifies FreeCursor.position. In-place removals have the literal Lua traversal behavior; no compensation is invented.
